data_mode.description: Switch between synthetic offline fixtures and live OpenAQ/CPCB ingestion.

stale_after_minutes.description: Threshold in minutes before station observations are flagged stale.

alert_cooldown_minutes.description: Cooldown between repeated alert triggers for the same location.

alert_hysteresis_factor.description: Fractional hysteresis threshold to avoid rapid flapping.

cpcb_aqi_enabled.description: Enable Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) NAQI calculation.

maintenance_mode.description: Put platform into read-only maintenance mode.
